name: 01151 · Indian Orch, MA
findings: ZIP 01151 (Indian Orch) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01151 (Indian Orch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
